# 🤖 EV3 examples: Sharpshooter Vision

[🔙 Back to Sharpshooter Vision](/en/sensors/unicam/index.md)　｜　[How EV3 reads it](/en/sensors/unicam/ev3/index.md)　｜　[📋 Value reference: EV3](/en/sensors/unicam/reference.md#host-ev3)

> [!WARNING]
> **v1 not yet hardware-verified**: the value layout is final and passed computer tests; real-hardware numbers (fps, line thresholds, I2C pins) may change after bench testing.

This page has **3 EV3 Python examples**: turn to follow a blob, colour at a spot, PD line following with a stop at a junction. The same program runs on **Pybricks v4** and on **LEGO EV3 MicroPython v2**; the library `MBC_UniCam_EV3.py` detects which one. EV3-G and EV3 Classroom read it with infrared sensor blocks, see [How EV3 reads it](/en/sensors/unicam/ev3/index.md).

| Software | How |
|---|---|
| 🐍 **Pybricks v4** ([code.pybricks.com](https://code.pybricks.com), EV3 needs the Pybricks firmware) | "Import a file" → import the example **and** [`MBC_UniCam_EV3.py`](/examples/unicam/ev3/MBC_UniCam_EV3.py) → ▶ |
| 🐍 **LEGO EV3 MicroPython v2** (microSD boot card + VS Code "LEGO MINDSTORMS EV3 MicroPython" extension) | put the example and `MBC_UniCam_EV3.py` in the same project folder → download and run |

> [!IMPORTANT]
> - The camera must run the **EV3 firmware**. On EV3 it shows up as a **LEGO infrared sensor**: mode 0 proximity = mode number, mode 1 seeker = 8 values, mode 2 remote = 4 values, mode 5 = device ID.
> - **EV3 can read the camera's current mode**: with `UniCam(Port.S1)` (no mode) the library reads mode 0 the first time (about 0.5 s more); the examples check the mode first and beep with a message if it is wrong.
> - **Every EV3 mode switch takes about 0.5 s**: in one loop use values of one EV3 mode when you can (the table below shows where each value is).

📦 All host libraries in one download: [MBC_UniCam_v1_Host_Libraries.zip](/downloads/MBC_UniCam_v1_Host_Libraries.zip)

## Before you start: teach colours and set the mode on the camera

1. **Teach a colour**: on the live view stop on "target 1" → **OK** → move the cross onto the colour (AxisX → AxisY) → **OK**.
2. **Set the mode**: left/right to **MODE** → **OK** → camera mode → **OK** → option → **OK**. "1-3" at the top right of the screen = mode number 13. Options show how many values EV3 really gets (for example "8 XY").

| Mode number | Camera menu | What EV3 gets |
|---|---|---|
| 11 | 1 Colour tracking, 1 Max | 12 colour positions (8×6 grid); colours 1~8 in mode 1, 9~12 in mode 2 |
| 12 | 1 Colour tracking, 2 Multi | 8 colour positions (mode 1) |
| 13 | 1 Colour tracking, 3 Standard | 4 colours: position + area % (mode 1) |
| 14 | 1 Colour tracking, 4 Fine | 2 colours: position, width/height (8×6 grid), count, area % (mode 1) |
| 21 | 2 Spot colour, 1 Hue | 12 spot hues (sent as 0~100, turned back into hue codes ±2); spots 1~8 mode 1, 9~12 mode 2 |
| 22 | 2 Spot colour, 2 | 4 spot hues (±2) + saturation, value (tens only) (mode 1) |
| 23 | 2 Spot colour, 3 | 2 spots: exact hue code, saturation, value (mode 1) |
| 30 | 3 Colour order | hues of 11 blocks from the left (±2) + total (modes 1 + 2) |
| 41 / 42 / 43 | 4 Line | near/mid/far offset, angle, width, junction, flags, junction distance, marker colour (mode 1); edges, far width, marker count (mode 2); no lost side on EV3 |

**Reading the numbers**: the library turns the EV3 8×6 grid **into pixels** (X 0~159 left → right, Y 0~119 top → bottom, same as SPIKE), using the cell centre, ±10 px; **(0, 0) = not found**. For the raw EV3 grid (Y bottom = small) use `grid(c)`. Line offsets −100~100: **standing behind the robot, line on the left = negative**.

## MBC_UniCam_EV3.py methods

`cam = UniCam(Port.S1)` or `UniCam(Port.S1, mode=13)` (port can also be 1~4). Method names are the same as SPIKE `MBC_UniCam.py`.

| Method | Returns | Modes |
|---|---|---|
| `mode_number()` | camera mode number (reads mode 0 when no mode was given) | all |
| `xy(c)`, `x(c)`, `y(c)`, `found(c)`, `grid(c)` | position (pixels ±10), found, raw 8×6 cell | 11~14 |
| `area(c)` | area % | 13, 14 |
| `size(c)`, `count(c)` | (width, height) pixels ±10, count | 14 |
| `max_color()` / `max_point()` | colours / spots in this mode | 1x / 2x |
| `hue(i)`, `sat(i)`, `val(i)`, `hsv(i)`, `color(i)` | hue code, saturation, value, colour name | 21~23 |
| `order()`, `total()` | hue codes from the left (≤11), total blocks | 30 |
| `near()` `mid()` `far()` `angle()` `width()` `junction()` `flags()` `junction_dist()` | line values (mode 1) | 41~43 |
| `edges()`, `far_width()`, `marker()`, `line_all()` | line values (need mode 2, +0.5 s) | 41~43 |
| `device_id()`, `is_unicam()`, `sensor_ok()` | mode 5: (0x4C, 3, 100), True, last read OK | all |

- Values EV3 does not get (counts in modes 11~13, colours found, lost side) raise `ValueError`; so does a wrong mode. Messages are bilingual.
- If the camera does not answer you get `None`; the examples check for `None` first.

## Example 1: turn to follow a colour blob

**What it does**: the robot turns toward colour 1 while driving forward; when the area is big it only turns; with nothing seen it spins slowly to search. At the start it checks that the camera is in mode 13.

**Camera mode**: camera mode 1 Colour tracking, option 3 Standard (XY + area) = **mode number 13**; teach "target 1" first.

**You need**: EV3 brick, camera in **port 1**, left wheel motor **B**, right wheel **C**, a ball or brick of the target colour.

**Download**: [ex01_track_turn.py](/examples/unicam/ev3/ex01_track_turn.py) + [MBC_UniCam_EV3.py](/examples/unicam/ev3/MBC_UniCam_EV3.py)

<details>
<summary>🐍 Python code (Pybricks v4 / EV3 MicroPython v2)</summary>

```python
#!/usr/bin/env pybricks-micropython
# 神攝手 × EV3 範例 1：跟著色塊轉
# Sharpshooter Vision × EV3 example 1: turn to follow a colour blob
# 需要把相機選單切到 相機模式 1 顏色追蹤 ・子選項 ③ 標準（XY＋面積）＝模式編號 13
# Camera menu: camera mode 1 Colour tracking, option 3 Standard (XY + area) = mode number 13
# 軟體 Software：Pybricks v4（code.pybricks.com）或 樂高官方 EV3 MicroPython v2（同一支程式都能跑）
# 準備：先在相機上教「目標 1」的顏色 / teach "target 1" on the camera first
# 接線 Wiring：相機 → 1 號孔 / camera → port 1；左輪 B、右輪 C / left wheel B, right wheel C
# 同一個資料夾要有 MBC_UniCam_EV3.py / put MBC_UniCam_EV3.py in the same folder
from pybricks.hubs import EV3Brick
from pybricks.ev3devices import Motor
from pybricks.parameters import Port
from pybricks.robotics import DriveBase
from pybricks.tools import wait
from MBC_UniCam_EV3 import UniCam

ev3 = EV3Brick()
cam = UniCam(Port.S1)                            # 不填 mode：自動讀相機目前的模式 / mode read from the camera
left = Motor(Port.B)
right = Motor(Port.C)
robot = DriveBase(left, right, 56, 114)          # 輪徑 56 mm、輪距 114 mm / wheel 56 mm, axle 114 mm

if cam.mode_number() != 13:                      # EV3 讀得到相機的模式，切錯了就提醒 / EV3 can check the mode
    print('請把相機切到 模式 13（顏色追蹤 ③）/ please set the camera to mode 13')
    ev3.speaker.beep(200, 500)
    wait(3000)
    raise SystemExit

KP = 3            # 👉 可以改：偏 1 像素就多轉幾度／秒 / turn rate per pixel of error
STOP_AREA = 20    # 👉 可以改：面積 ≥ 20 % 就算很近 / area (%) that counts as "close"

while True:
    p = cam.xy(1)                                # 色 1 的 (X, Y) 像素（EV3 是 8×6 格，±10）/ pixels (±10 on EV3)
    if p is None:                                # 讀不到相機 / no camera
        robot.stop()
    elif p[0] == 0:                              # 沒看到：原地慢慢轉著找 / not seen: spin to search
        robot.drive(0, 60)
    else:
        error = p[0] - 80                        # 畫面中間 X = 80；色塊在右 → 正 / right of centre = positive
        speed = 0 if cam.area(1) >= STOP_AREA else 80
        robot.drive(speed, error * KP)           # 面積在同一個模式（模式 1），不用多等 / same EV3 mode, no wait
    wait(20)
```

</details>

**Step by step**
1. `UniCam(Port.S1)`: no mode → `cam.mode_number()` reads mode 0 for the camera's mode number; if it is not 13 the program warns and ends.
2. `cam.xy(1)`, `cam.area(1)`: both in EV3 mode 1 (seeker), no mode switch.
3. `error = X − 80`: right of centre is positive → positive turn = turn right.

**What you should see**: ball on the left → turns left; on the right → turns right; close → turns on the spot; no ball → spins to search.

**Common problems**
- **Beeps and ends at once?** → the camera is not in mode 13: in the camera menu choose MODE → "1 Colour tracking → 3"; the screen should show `1-3`.
- **Wobbles?** → EV3 positions are an 8×6 grid (20 px per cell); use a smaller `KP` (for example 2).

## Example 2: what colour is at the spot?

**What it does**: reads the exact hue code, saturation and value of spots S1 and S2, prints the colour; when S1 is red, green, orange or yellow the EV3 light shows it; prints one more line when both spots are the same colour.

**Camera mode**: camera mode 2 Spot colour, option 3 Hue + saturation + value = **mode number 23** (2 spots on EV3, exact values).

**You need**: EV3 brick, camera in **port 1**, coloured bricks.

**Download**: [ex02_spot_color.py](/examples/unicam/ev3/ex02_spot_color.py) + [MBC_UniCam_EV3.py](/examples/unicam/ev3/MBC_UniCam_EV3.py)

<details>
<summary>🐍 Python code (Pybricks v4 / EV3 MicroPython v2)</summary>

```python
#!/usr/bin/env pybricks-micropython
# 神攝手 × EV3 範例 2：座標取色判斷顏色
# Sharpshooter Vision × EV3 example 2: what colour is at the spot?
# 需要把相機選單切到 相機模式 2 座標取色 ・子選項 ③ 色相＋飽和＋明度 ＝模式編號 23（EV3 給 2 點，原始值）
# Camera menu: camera mode 2 Spot colour, option 3 Hue + sat + value = mode number 23 (2 spots, exact values)
# 軟體 Software：Pybricks v4 或 樂高官方 EV3 MicroPython v2
# 準備：取樣點 S1、S2 的位置看相機螢幕上標 1、2 的十字 / spots S1, S2 are the crosses on the camera screen
# 接線 Wiring：相機 → 1 號孔 / camera → port 1
from pybricks.hubs import EV3Brick
from pybricks.parameters import Port, Color
from pybricks.tools import wait
from MBC_UniCam_EV3 import UniCam, color_name

ev3 = EV3Brick()
cam = UniCam(Port.S1, mode=23)                   # 填了 mode 就不用先讀模式 0 / giving mode skips one mode switch

NAME = {'red': '紅', 'orange': '橙', 'yellow': '黃', 'green': '綠', 'cyan': '青',
        'blue': '藍', 'purple': '紫', 'white': '白／灰', 'black': '黑'}
LIGHT = {'red': Color.RED, 'orange': Color.ORANGE, 'yellow': Color.YELLOW, 'green': Color.GREEN}
LOW_SAT = 15      # 👉 可以改：飽和度比這低就當成白／灰 / below this saturation = white / grey

while True:
    names = []
    for point in (1, 2):
        p = cam.hsv(point)                       # (色相碼, 飽和度, 明度) / (hue, sat, val)
        if p is None:
            names.append(None)
            continue
        n = color_name(p[0])
        if p[1] < LOW_SAT and n != 'black':
            n = 'white'
        names.append(n)
        print('S%d 色相碼 hue %d 飽和 sat %d 明度 val %d → %s %s' % (point, p[0], p[1], p[2], NAME[n], n))
    if names[0] in LIGHT:                        # EV3 的燈只有紅、綠、橙、黃 / EV3 light: red, green, orange, yellow
        ev3.light.on(LIGHT[names[0]])
    else:
        ev3.light.off()
    if names[0] is not None and names[0] == names[1]:
        print('兩點一樣顏色 / both spots are the same colour')
    wait(300)
```

</details>

**Step by step**
1. `UniCam(Port.S1, mode=23)`: with the mode given there is no mode-0 read.
2. `cam.hsv(point)`: EV3 mode 23 stores one hue code in two values (hundreds and remainder); the library joins them back to 0~255.
3. `color_name()`: hue code → colour name, same limits as the SPIKE library.

**What you should see**: two lines every 0.3 s, for example `S1 色相碼 hue 5 飽和 sat 80 明度 val 70 → 紅 red`.

**Common problems**
- **More spots?** → mode 21 gives 12 spot hues (±2), but spots 9~12 are in mode 2 (+0.5 s).
- **Saturation and value only in tens?** → that is mode 22 (EV3 packs two numbers into one value); use mode 23 for exact values.

## Example 3: PD line following + stop at a junction

**What it does**: PD line following that mostly uses the near offset and turns early with the far offset; stops and beeps at a cross or T junction; when none of the three scan lines sees the line it turns toward the side of the last error. It only uses EV3 mode-1 values, so there is no mode switch in the loop.

**Camera mode**: camera mode 4 Line, option 1 Black line = **mode number 41** (white 42 and colour 43 also work; the program checks it is a line mode).

**You need**: EV3 brick, camera in **port 1** at the front looking down and forward, left wheel **B**, right wheel **C**, a black line on white.

**Download**: [ex03_line_follow.py](/examples/unicam/ev3/ex03_line_follow.py) + [MBC_UniCam_EV3.py](/examples/unicam/ev3/MBC_UniCam_EV3.py)

<details>
<summary>🐍 Python code (Pybricks v4 / EV3 MicroPython v2)</summary>

```python
#!/usr/bin/env pybricks-micropython
# 神攝手 × EV3 範例 3：PD 循線＋路口停車
# Sharpshooter Vision × EV3 example 3: PD line following + stop at a junction
# 需要把相機選單切到 相機模式 4 循線 ・子選項 ① 黑線 ＝模式編號 41（白線 42、色線 43 也可以）
# Camera menu: camera mode 4 Line, option 1 Black line = mode number 41 (42 / 43 also work)
# 軟體 Software：Pybricks v4 或 樂高官方 EV3 MicroPython v2
# 準備：相機裝在車頭、斜斜往前下方看線 / camera at the front, looking down and forward
# 接線 Wiring：相機 → 1 號孔；左輪 B、右輪 C / camera → port 1; left wheel B, right wheel C
# 方向：站在車後往前看，線在左＝負 / standing behind the robot: line on the left = negative
# EV3 每換一次模式約 0.5 秒：這支只用模式 1 的值（近、遠、旗標、路口）/ only mode-1 values (no mode switch)
from pybricks.hubs import EV3Brick
from pybricks.ev3devices import Motor
from pybricks.parameters import Port
from pybricks.robotics import DriveBase
from pybricks.tools import wait
from MBC_UniCam_EV3 import UniCam

ev3 = EV3Brick()
cam = UniCam(Port.S1)
left = Motor(Port.B)
right = Motor(Port.C)
robot = DriveBase(left, right, 56, 114)

if cam.mode_number() not in (41, 42, 43):        # 相機沒切到循線就提醒 / camera not in line mode
    print('請把相機切到 循線（模式 41／42／43）/ please set the camera to line mode')
    ev3.speaker.beep(200, 500)
    wait(3000)
    raise SystemExit

SPEED = 120       # 👉 可以改：前進速度 mm/s / forward speed
KP = 1.5          # 👉 可以改：比例 / proportional gain
KD = 4.0          # 👉 可以改：微分 / derivative gain
last_error = 0

while True:
    junction = cam.junction()                    # 0 無 1 十字 2 T 3 左 4 右 5 盡頭 / junction type
    if junction is None:                         # 讀不到相機：停車 / no camera: stop
        robot.stop()
        wait(50)
        continue
    if junction in (1, 2):                       # 十字或 T 字路口：停車嗶一聲 / cross or T: stop
        robot.stop()
        ev3.speaker.beep()
        break
    if cam.flags() == 0:                         # 近中遠都沒看到線：往上一次偏的那邊找 / line lost
        robot.drive(0, -120 if last_error < 0 else 120)
        wait(10)
        continue
    error = 0.7 * cam.near() + 0.3 * cam.far()   # 近處為主、遠處提早轉彎 / mostly near, a bit of far
    turn = KP * error + KD * (error - last_error)
    last_error = error
    robot.drive(SPEED, turn)                     # 線在左（負）→ 往左轉 / line on the left → turn left
    wait(10)
```

</details>

**Step by step**
1. `cam.junction()`: junction type (0 none 1 cross 2 T 3 left 4 right 5 end); EV3 keeps it in one value with the line flags (junction × 10 + flags), the library splits it.
2. `cam.flags()`: near 1 + mid 2 + far 4; 0 = no line seen.
3. `error = 0.7 × near + 0.3 × far`: line on the left is negative → turn left; `KD` makes the turns smoother.

**What you should see**: the robot follows the line and turns early before curves; at the cross junction it stops, beeps and the program ends.

**Common problems**
- **Slow and jerky?** → `edges()`, `far_width()`, `marker()` and `line_all()` switch to mode 2 (0.5 s each time); do not use them in the line loop.
- **Wobbles a lot?** → smaller `KP`, bigger `KD`, or a slower `SPEED`.

## Please note

- **Nothing here has run on hardware yet**: the value layout was checked value by value on a computer against the independent reference implementation of the spec (both the Pybricks v4 and the EV3 MicroPython v2 reading); the EV3 MicroPython v2 `Ev3devSensor` mode names (IR-PROX, IR-SEEK, IR-REMOTE, IR-CAL) follow the LEGO infrared sensor and need a hardware check.
- KP/KD and area limits are suggestions; print the numbers first, then tune.
